answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 4227 Country: India Title: Can eating food at any hidu's ivitation is halal or haram? Question: assalamva alaikum, can eating food at any hidu's ivitation is halal or haram Answer ID: 4227 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 288/288=M/1429) One can eat at a Hindu?s invitation provided one is sure that neither a haram (impure) agent is used in the food nor it is offering of Hindu gods and goddesses: لا باس بالذھاب الی ضیافۃ اھل الذمۃ (الھندیۃ) ۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
